title: Tao Heung Foods of Mankind Museum
scope: The original two-storey Tao Heung Food Museum at 1 Lok Tin Street, Fanling, as photographed in October 2006. The glazed entrance below the projecting sign canopy, two stairs and metal forecourt gates are included.
limitations: The model is the 2006 Fanling building. The present museum in Fo Tan is at a different address.
Unseen rear elevations, museum signage and fixtures are simplified. Temporary displays and the earlier interior exhibition are outside scope.
